name: Keith K.
text: I am a user of the CRT lenses and it's tough to find an optometry office that knows them well. It's even harder to find an office that specializes in them, so I was lucky to have been introduced to 1234 Ortho-K. I actually had no idea what an ortho-k lens was, but it turns out it’s just a different name for the CRT lenses. At 1234 the staff and Dr. Woo walked me through the pros and cons and the benefits of newer lenses. The staff seems well trained and all are very attentive and quick to answer questions or call for help from other members. Dr. Woo is thoughtful, knowledgeable, and doesn't mind explaining what he's doing and why. He also has a good sense of humor and bedside manner.

name: Jenny C.
text: Dr. Woo is extremely attentive, professional, patient, and knowledgeable. Elaine is a super sweet and capable woman. Whenever I encounter an issue, she is the first person I go to for advice. I remember on many occasions where Elaine will go out of her way to make sure my needs are met and help me follow up with Dr. Woo. The staff is always happy to help and friendly (even during peak hours). It is really a good clinic with such a nice clean environment and excellent customer service. I will be sticking to 1234 Eye Care Clinic for a very long time and will recommend my family and friends as well. Definitely 5 stars worthy!

name: Charlie P.
text: Never knew much about Ortho-k until my daughter needed glasses. I did some research and found Dr. Paul Woo. We talked over the phone and he was such a professional. He thoroughly explained the technology to me and was very patient while understanding our needs. After several discussions we decided to visit the office and have a consultation meeting. There was no pressure throughout the process and experience with all the staff was very pleasant. We have now been with Dr. Woo for 2 year running and we can't be happier. I would say Dr. Woo really knows Ortho-K with his 20+ years of experience in this field. I would not hesitate to recommend my family, friends and others to 1234 Eye Care Clinic.

name: Thomas L.
text: I've been going here for 16 years, ever since I was a blind-as-a-bat 4th grader. Now I've graduated from college and am working full time in Seattle and I still come back for Dr. Woo's appointments! The ortho-k lenses have always been really important to me because it's made my life so much easier! I don't have to struggle to see presentations in class and at work, and I'm never freaking out about misplacing my glasses! I highly recommend you stop by here and give Dr. Woo a shot! He's very easy to work with and you won't regret it!

name: Aubrey T.
text: Came here for the Ortho-K lens treatment. Just finished up the program and things are good with the lenses. Was my first time using any sort of lens. The staff was helpful in explaining how to care for the lenses. Dr. Woo is friendly and caring. I've had a great experience here and would recommend getting ortho-k lenses from here.

name: Maddi M.
text: Dr. Woo has been my optometrist for half a decade, and I've only ever had positive experiences! I used to get new glasses here every year before switching to contact lenses, and they always have tons of pretty frames in lots of styles and colors. Not to mention the nose rests actually fit Asian faces (if you've ever had sunglasses slide down your face all day, you know how non-negotiable this is!) Everyone here is always very friendly and professional when I come in, and all my appointments have been super smooth and efficient. Plus, the whole staff speaks various dialects of Chinese in addition to English.

name: Carol W.
text: My entire family has been going to 1234 eye care since 2002. Unlike most places that try to squeeze the most money out of you during every visit, Dr. Woo and his staff always have our best interests at heart. My eyesight kept getting worse as a teen, so Dr. Woo recommended trying gas permeable contacts, since they can actually help preserve your vision.

name: Martin M.
text: I would just like to take the time to thank Dr. Woo at 1234 Ortho-K for saving my vision! Coming from a family with hereditary eye degenerative disorder, Dr. Woo was a blessing! My parents and grandparents are all over 1000 degrees, so if I didn't have Dr. Woo, my eyes would be somewhere close to 2000 degrees at this point in time. In the last decade, he has managed to keep my eyes down to 900 degrees (which is REALLY good considering I could easily be at 1600+ at his point in my life.) With Ortho-K, life was so much easier! Dr. Woo takes great care of your eyes and he is always open to questions. He won't sugarcoat anything; he always tells the TRUTH. My family has been there for two generations now and I am sure that I will take my kids there in the future. Go to Dr. Woo and I'm sure you won't regret it!

name: Ellen Z.
text: I have already been to quite a few eye care places in China, and my family is disappointed because after all the treatments. When we came to the US, we came across 1234 by chance and it was one of the luckiest things that had ever happened in my life. I took my glasses off and saw the world just fine after barely a month. If you are looking for Eye Care places, I highly recommend 1234. The doctors are super nice, and they always give you very helpful advice. Again, I highly recommend this amazing place!

name: Colin C.
text: Decided to try out Ortho-K since my laboratory work prohibits the use of day wear contact lenses. I searched a number of providers around SoCal and found 1234 Eye Care had very positive reviews. I had most of my initial questions answered over the phone and scheduled a next day appointment to visit the clinic to get evaluated for the lenses. I was welcomed by a very friendly and efficient staff who whisked me through a series of screening tests to ensure I was a suitable candidate, which I was. By the 1st month follow up I was seeing with better than 20/20 vision! This obviously has exceeded my expectations. Additionally, my eyes no longer suffer from dryness that I experienced from contact lenses. I've been wearing them for 4 months now and am very satisfied with the results. Naturally, using overnight contact lenses is not for everyone but if the routine can fit your schedule and lifestyle, the results are wonderful. Thank you, Dr. Woo and team.

name: Johnny C.
text: Dr. Woo then explained the technology and treatment, answering all the questions I had and outlining the steps and expected results. I was fitted with lenses that day and found them surprisingly comfortable, relative to the reviews I had read online; Dr Woo ordered a set for me which I picked up the following week. The price of the therapy was very competitive and the number of patients they have treated gives them experience that few others can match. I highly recommend Dr Woo and the staff at 1234 Eye Care. They are knowledgeable, professional, and all-around kind and caring individuals. 20/20 would recommend!

name: Vivian W.
text: I was introduced to Ortho-K lens a few years ago, and absolutely fall in love with it. Before that, I thought I was going to be stuck with contact lenses that dries my eyes out in the morning, and unflattering glasses that would create steams that blocks my vision, which demolish my relationship with noodles. Now that I have the Ortho-K lens, I can see better than ever. Recently, I even went back to get a new pair of glasses for my personal reason, I was surprised to find out that my vision had improved so much! I am truly grateful that I was introduced to the Ortho-K lens. Not to mention, the doctor and staff are patience and sweet, literally the best optometry clinic that I've been to, highly recommended!!
